liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Bertha** (1 review): Reviewer found Bertha troubled by issues that made it a little hard to listen to [9]
- **St. Stephen** (1 review): Stretch from St. Stephen through Throwing Stones was exploratory and bluesy, with John Mayer and Otiel visibly engaged up close [6]

## Setlist highlights

- **Greatest Story Ever Told**: rare: 12 archived performances [10]
- **William Tell Bridge**: rare: 14 archived performances [10]
- **Liberty**: back after 50 archived shows (386 days); rare: 13 archived performances [10]

## The recordings

- **DeadCo2018-07-13.travitz.SchoepsMK4v.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 21 songs; 190 min; rated 4.75/5 by 4 [1]
- **deadandco2018-07-13.661.spyder9.flac16**: source not stated; 21 songs; 189 min [2]
- **deadandco2018-07-13.set2e.CA14.flac16**: source not stated; 11 songs; 115 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [3]. Said about its sound: Crisp recording with little crowd noise [6]

## Around the show

- Reviewer's last show was Highgate, VT in 1995, where Bobby left the stage; this was their return [5]
- Taper stood front of board, dead center, about 60 feet from the stage [3]
- Reviewer attended both Boulder nights and says others are down on this show, perhaps preferring hits and singalongs [6]

## Tapers and lineage

- **DeadCo2018-07-13.travitz.SchoepsMK4v.flac16**: taped by Jeff Travitz; transferred by Keith Litzenberger; source: Schoeps MK4V's>KCY 250/05i>Schoeps VMS5u>Sound Devices 744t [1]. Also: Keith Litzenberger processed it: Sound Forge fades, CDWAV tracking, Trader's Little Helper FLAC, Foobar2000 tagging [1]
- **deadandco2018-07-13.661.spyder9.flac16**: taped by Dan Nolan, Jr. - spyder9; transferred by Dan Nolan, Jr. - spyder9; source: AKG C568EB > Marantz PMD661 (Oade-w) (24/44.1) [2]
- **deadandco2018-07-13.set2e.CA14.flac16**: taped by Lucas Lorenz; transferred by Lucas Lorenz; source: Church Audio CA 14 omnis (approx. 8" apart, PAS, on Richie Stankiewicz's Jecklin disk), Church Audio CA9200 (+10 gain), Roland R-05 (24/48 wav) [3]. Also: Covers only set two and the encore, since the recorder was paused throughout the first set [3]
